overview_description.description: TigerEye provides AI tools for construction professionals to manage information and documents. The platform organizes and links sources, summaries, and submittals to save time on searches and approvals. Data is stored securely and privacy is maintained, following standards such as SOC2, CCPA, GDPR, and ISO certifications. The platform includes knowledge and practices from experienced construction superintendents. It supports construction teams by making information easier to access and manage on-site. The system integrates modern AI technology to assist with daily field operations and project management.

product.name: TigerEye AI Analyst
product.description: An AI-powered conversational business intelligence tool that provides instant answers to go-to-market questions about pipeline, accounts, and revenue.

product.name: TigerChat
product.description: A conversational interface within TigerEye that understands go-to-market concepts and answers detailed questions about sales and marketing data.

product.name: TigerEye Official Metrics
product.description: A feature that standardizes and enforces key business metric definitions across all data views and reports within the platform.

product.name: Pipeline Coverage
product.description: A unified analytics view that monitors sales pipeline health, tracks funnel activity, and assesses risk to sales targets.

product.name: Radar
product.description: An AI-driven summary tool that tracks key business changes and provides customized updates since the user’s last login.

product.name: Data Explorer
product.description: A query builder tool that enables analysts to write and customize SQL queries with developer-grade features for advanced data exploration.
